title: Observing conformal Floquet dynamics on a digital quantum processor
abstract: First experimental observation of non-equilibrium Floquet dynamics starting from a many-body critical state prepared via a logarithmic-depth MERA-based circuit on a trapped-ion processor. Extracts central charge c=1/2 (Ising) from Loschmidt-echo decay; observes spatial energy localization and finite-time revivals in the non-heating phase.
key_claims: MERA-prepared critical state used as input to Floquet dynamics on a real trapped-ion processor (log-depth circuit).
Central charge c=1/2 extracted from Loschmidt-echo decay; CFT verification protocol demonstrated on hardware.
Directly transferable methodology template for testing holographic observables on MERA-prepared states on hardware.
